    AI Overview
    "i" is a Grammy-winning 2014 song by Kendrick Lamar from his album To Pimp a Butterfly, known for its positive message of self-love and resilience. The song, which heavily samples the Isley Brothers, was released on September 23, 2014, and is recognized for its live, high-energy production. It won two Grammys for Best Rap Song and Best Rap Performance. 
    Key Details About "i" by Kendrick Lamar: 
    • Theme: The track is a direct response to self-doubt, negativity, and the pressures of life, emphasizing self-worth.
    • Grammy Success: The song received two Grammys for Best Rap Song and Best Rap Performance at the 57th Grammy Awards
      .
    • Production: The song is notable for featuring a "live" feel in its production, including a spoken-word performance in the middle of the track.
    • Reception: It was widely adopted as an anthem of self-empowerment and received critical acclaim for its upbeat and hopeful message.
    • Usage: The song has been featured in several films and commercials, including trailers for Top Five, Dope, How to Be Single, and The Intern.
